cards.answer: In una piccola città vicino al mare.
cards.notes: Where did you live as a child? / In a small town near the sea.
What were you like as a little girl? / I was very lively and curious.
What did you want to be when you grew up? / I wanted to be a teacher.
Did you like school? / Quite, but I hated maths.
What did you do in the summer? / We always went camping.
Did you have pets? / Yes, we had a cat.

cards.answer: Era vecchia, con un grande giardino.
cards.notes: What was your house like? / It was old, with a big garden.

cards.prompt: Cosa facevi quando ti ho chiamato?
cards.notes: What were you doing when I called? / I was cooking, sorry. Stare + -ando/-endo: something in progress.
What was the weather like on holiday? / It was really hot.
What was the restaurant like? / Nice, but it was too crowded.
Did you know? / No, I didn't know anything about it.

cards.answer: Ero stanca e non avevo voglia.
cards.notes: Why didn't you come? / I was tired and didn't feel like it.
